=== Basic Tools ===
*[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15cGQmmbqk2wSmuX-oTkSfwuC818sn4wT?usp=sharing FPAN Modding Resources]

 Contains:
 * Hantei-chan 2.1.6
 * CGLib
 * CGTool 


*[https://github.com/DamienIsPoggers/Hantei-chan Hantei-chan with jonbin] (DamienIsPoggers, can convert to BlazBlue files, optional)

*[https://www.mediafire.com/file/vaxwip4wgsr4bft/win-x86.zip/file Pat Editor] by u4ick, incompatible with some modern game dds types

*[https://notepad-plus-plus.org/downloads/ Notepad++]. Other text editors may be fine, but Notepad++ gets the best results due to it's SHIFT-JIS encoder.

*[https://mh-nexus.de/en/hxd/ HxD], or any other hex editor.

*DDS decomp/compression tool. Found in the .pat cut-ins guide.

=== Game Specific Injectors / Extractors ===
'''MBTL'''
*[https://github.com/Eiton/MBTL-Hitbox-Viewer MBTL Hitbox Viewer], injector
*[https://github.com/Ekey/MBTL.BIN.Tool/releases MBTL BIN Tool], file extractor

'''MBTL CACHE FOR BIN TOOL'''
*[https://www.mediafire.com/file/qphp76tvujvoiv9/cache_1_26_25.zip/file Cache for Update 1.46], 5/23/2024
*[https://www.mediafire.com/file/df097odukl22jee/cache_5_7_24.zip/file Cache for Update 1.45], 5/7/2024

'''UNDER NIGHT'''

*[https://github.com/ucuckic/unist-unpacker/releases/tag/4 UNIST Unpacker], works for UNI2
*[https://github.com/ucuckic/unist-unpacker/releases/tag/3 UNIST Unpacker], works for UNICLR
*[https://github.com/Ekey/UNIB.Data.Tool/tree/main UNIB Data Tool] UNI2 only.
*[https://www.mediafire.com/file/6ftwpto9dy9eyau/uni2datatool.zip/file UNIB Data Tool] compiled by pixloen. Includes batch file for easy usage.
